answer: Social Matters >> Nikah (Marriage) Question ID: 9577 Country: India Title: Is Waleema permissible only after a man's first nikah or he can have a waleema each time that he divorces his previous wife and remarries again. Question: Is Waleema permissible only after a man's first nikah or he can have a waleema each time that he divorces his previous wife and remarries again. Answer ID: 9577 Posted on: Aug 28, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 2514/2068=B/1429) Walimah is not related specially with ones first Nikah, rather it is sunnah to give walimah feast each time one marries. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
